# 2.8.1. Casos 1,4,5

```{r}
library(BSDA)
x = rnorm(30, mean=5, sd=0.82)
y = rnorm(35, mean=5.5, sd=1.72)

DEx <- 0.82
DEy <- 1.72
conf_level <- 0.95
z.test(x,y,conf.level = conf_level, sigma.x = DEx, sigma.y = DEy)
```

# Casos 2 y 3

En el caso en que no conocemos la varianza, hacemos:

```{r}
x = rnorm(30, mean=5, sd=0.82)
y = rnorm(35, mean=5.5, sd=1.72)
t.test(x, y, var.equal = FALSE, conf.level = 0.95)
```
